summary: Live camera panel: RTSP feeds, grid, wall, enlarged views and pins
description: View and manage IP cameras from a panel: a grid, one enlarged, a wall, add and edit forms with NVR scan and discovery, ffprobe connection tests, and cameras pinned to the desktop as their own windows.
